summary.zh: 一个按钮四种状态：下载 → 下载中（暂停图标 + 进度环）→ 已暂停（播放图标）→ 完成（对勾 + 迸出小点）。图标不是淡入淡出换的，是每个顶点挂着弹簧变过去，还会拧一下。进度也不是匀速的。
summary.en: One button, four states: download → downloading (pause icon + progress ring) → paused (play icon) → done (tick + burst). Icons do not crossfade; every vertex springs to its new spot with a little twist. Progress is not linear either.

technique.zh: 所有图标都由两个四边形（8 个顶点）组成，粗线段用 bar(x1,y1,x2,y2,w) 算出四个角，三角形就重复一个点。切换时每个顶点独立弹到新形状的对应点，并错峰 14ms；整组再加一个旋转冲量。用 fill + 同色粗 stroke 做圆角。
technique.en: Every icon is two quads (8 vertices); thick strokes come from bar(x1,y1,x2,y2,w), triangles repeat a vertex. On change each vertex springs to its counterpart with a 14ms stagger, plus an angular kick on the group. Rounded corners come from fill plus a same-colour thick stroke.

desc.zh: 顶点弹簧阻尼，越小越抖

adapt.zh: 接真实下载：进度写进 prog（0~100），完成时调 go('done')。想加新图标，只要再写一组 8 个点。
adapt.en: For real downloads write progress into prog (0–100) and call go('done') at the end. A new icon is just another set of 8 points.
